scope: Resolve Data19 (Short-term rental share) from PARTIAL to VERIFIED. InsideAirbnb is non-viable for EL62 (no Ionian Islands coverage; Greece key returned HTTP 403). The authoritative substitute is Eurostat tour_ce_omn12 (short-stay accommodation offered via online platforms — the EC data-sharing agreement with Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia and Tripadvisor). Compute Data19(Y) = NGT_SP_platform / (NGT_conventional + NGT_SP_platform) * 100 against tour_occ_nin2 for EL62 (2018–2025), emit annual observations, and retain the 2025 monthly seasonality profile (research-notes 2026-10-15 §7).

evidence.name: Short-stay accommodation offered via online platforms — nights spent (NUTS2, EL62, annual 2018-2025)
evidence.provider: Eurostat (ec.europa.eu/eurostat), under the EC platform data-sharing agreement (Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, Tripadvisor)
evidence.schema_observation: JSON-stat 2.0; dimensions [freq, indic_to, c_resid, month, unit, geo, time]; NGT_SP = Nights spent, c_resid=TOTAL, month=TOTAL, geo=EL62 (Ionia Nisia). Values (nights): 2018 3,055,815 · 2019 3,389,027 · 2020 1,274,758 · 2021 2,768,197 · 2022 5,220,869 · 2023 6,069,273 · 2024 4,400,084 · 2025 8,644,420.
evidence.note: Authoritative official source for platform-mediated guest nights at NUTS2. InsideAirbnb (the earlier candidate) is superseded: it has zero Ionian Islands coverage (Greece = Athens/Crete only) and the guessed Athens key returned HTTP 403.

evidence.name: Short-stay accommodation offered via online platforms — 2025 monthly breakdown (NUTS2, EL62)
evidence.schema_observation: JSON-stat 2.0; month dimension TOTAL + M01..M12 for time=2025. Jul = 2,182,817 · Aug = 2,348,265 · May = 534,823 · Oct = 419,047 · Jan = 8,342 · Feb = 11,511; Jul+Aug = 4,531,082 (52.4 % of the 2025 total).
evidence.note: Seasonality profile (research-notes §7D): over half of annual platform volume is concentrated in July-August.

evidence.name: Nights spent at tourist accommodation establishments (NUTS2, EL62, annual 2018-2025) — conventional denominator
evidence.note: Same dataset already verified for Data16/26/31/33 (source key Eurostat_tour_occ_nin2); re-pulled here only to align the conventional-nights denominator to the full 2018–2025 window.

evidence.name: Data19 short-term rental share % — derived result (2018-2025, NUTS2/EL62)
evidence.provider: IonianDTwin derivation (pull-data19-platform-rentals.py) over Eurostat tour_ce_omn12 + tour_occ_nin2
evidence.schema_observation: Audit JSON: per-year platform_nights, conventional_nights, total_tourism_nights, share_pct; plus sources (url, sha256, updated) and 2025 monthly seasonality.
evidence.note: RESULT (share % = platform / total tourism nights): 2018 14.50 · 2019 15.88 · 2020 22.08 · 2021 23.02 · 2022 24.02 · 2023 23.50 · 2024 17.65 · 2025 29.80. FLAG: 2025 platform nights (8,644,420) are +96 % vs 2024 (4,400,084) — likely a platform-coverage/onboarding change in the EC agreement rather than true market growth; treat the 2025 share cautiously and re-verify against the next Eurostat release. Emitted as 8 schema-compliant annual observations Eurostat_tour_ce_omn12:Data19:platform_rental_share:<year> (NUTS2/EL62).
